title: lilium pyrenaicum subsp. carniolicum
intro: Lilium pyrenaicum subsp. carniolicum, commonly known as the Carniolan lily, is a subspecies of the lily plant found in the mountainous regions of Central and Eastern Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lilium pyrenaicum subsp. carniolicum include reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
